title: Qwen3.6-27B bounded source-F16 direct rocBLAS BF16 output screen

software.header_contract: rocblas_gemm_ex lists homogeneous F16 with F16/F32 compute, F16 inputs with F32 C/D and F32 compute, homogeneous BF16 with F32 compute, and BF16 inputs with F32 C/D and F32 compute; it does not list F16 A/B with BF16 C/D.

candidate.description: Call rocblas_gemm_ex with FP16 A/B, BF16 C/D, FP16 compute, and an explicit destination leading dimension larger than the tile width so the GEMM would publish directly into the final strided BF16 output.
candidate.intended_removed_work: one strided FP16-to-BF16 cast after each bounded source-F16 tile GEMM

predeclared_stop_gate: Stop at the leaf on any unsupported or mismatching shape; do not load actual 27B weights or run the second board when the library rejects the datatype tuple before launch.
decision: Reject and do not add a Rocblas API wrapper, kernel composite, runtime policy, test surface, or fallback flag. The installed rocBLAS does not implement the required FP16-input/FP16-compute/BF16-output GEMM_EX tuple. Retain FP16 output plus the exact strided BF16 cast.
